text_block_list.name: Serial Trespasser Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wh- kblfpfbt! Where'd these feathers come from!? Wait, what the— I can't get this crap off!

text_block_list.name: Stress Eater Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what is this!? No matter! Where I step! It makes! Noise! 
What the heeeeeck!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I knew it… If I bragged about how cool my traps are, 
no bad guy would be able to help themselves!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! Enjoying your stay in sticky feather heck!? 
Can't get them off, now can you!? Bet it really ticks you off!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Result Sheet
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow, a suspicious looking string. That's the most obvious trap I've eve—— COLD! Was that a water gun!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're so naive! Obviously I set some fakes! 
Muahahahahaha! You intruders look so ridiculous!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I know exactly how you bad guys think! All I had to do was 
tease you a little bit, and you'd come running! 
You guys were so easy to bait ♪

text_block_list.name: Serial Trespasser Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ngh… You were talking such a big game back there! 
Of course I'd wanna try and take you down a peg!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you guys acting so bad, I got all the intruders 
in one place! Looks like my plan was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Now that you're here, let's get down to business! 
We want you all to stop sneaking into the archive room!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Result Sheet
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, so you really are with the Disciplinary Committee! 
You round us all up and hand us over to them, is that it!?

text_block_list.name: Graffiti Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait! I don't think that's right. 
I mean… That's not what Urara-san said in her notes.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
! Wait, are you… "Miss Pace-Blind"!? 
Whoa, you really came! Yippee!

text_block_list.name: Graffiti Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I couldn't just not show up after seeing how 
passionately you were trying to reach out. 
I thought I should at least try talking to you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "You race with front runners too! When I race with front runners they're so fast! They're so awesome!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "They go WHOOSH right out of the gate and leave me behind. When the pace is… ecks-selerated? They get further and further!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"But I like it when they do because it's fun because I get to 
chase them! Whenever I get closer and closer I get so excited!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder how excited I would be if I chased them and won? 
I can't wait to do that someday! 
——Love, Haru Urara"

text_block_list.name: Graffiti Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
When I read your messages… I got the feeling you figured out 
why we were coming here. Right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Obviously. We're all racers too. 
We know everyone at Tracen needs this place.

text_block_list.name: Graffiti Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
See, what'd I tell you? Let's hear 'em out. 
Haru Urara never gives up, no matter how many times she loses. 
And I came here 'cuz I wanna hear what she has to say.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
We're not here because we wanna catch you! 
Our job was to investigate the archive!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
All that means is the school wants to know why you're 
doing this. So I think we can find a compromise!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What we want is for you guys to stop sneaking in. 
So what do you guys want? Please, tell us!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I promise we'll pass it on to the school!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Result Sheet
text_block_list.text:
…You seriously are just here to talk, huh? 
Honestly, I like, didn't expect that… Well, more like, the 
fact that you guys seem to really get it is——

text_block_list.name: Serial Trespasser Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Honestly? I'm glad. If you wanted to, you guys could've 
called us sore losers lashing out, or thugs who can't control 
our anger. But you didn't.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'd never call you stuff like that! 
I mean, I get all chompy when I lose too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Result Sheet
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, chompy!? You really are a bad guy, huh! 
…Yeah, all right. Let's think of a way we can compromise with 
the school. Together.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: We… we did iiiiiiiiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Incredible… What a brilliant plan!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I knew I was right to put my faith in this squad!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Captain Fenomeno!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please, leave the rest to me…! I promise, I will not let down 
the trust you all have placed in me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-w-w-w-what are you doing here!? 
If you come here, you'll——

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right. I made sure to get proper approval first. 
I simply had to see how heroic you all were in action!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Captaaaaaaaaaaain!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhhhh! Captain! 
Did you see? I did my bestest!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I did. You're a hard worker who always runs with a smile. 
That's why they were willing to listen to you. 
That was something only you could have done!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Big-san, your perseverance let the squad keep moving forward! 
Biko-san, your kind, understanding words showed them how 
sincere you were!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And Windy-san, your "bad guy" strategy paved the way to 
solving this case! The four of you made full use of all your 
strengths, and worked together as an incredible team…!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Truly… Truly, you're all… I… I'M SORRY! I'M AT A LOSS FOR WORDS!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Thank goodness… Sniff! I… I did good, didn't I…!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
……You're all crybabies. 
But I'm not gonna cry… Bad guys don't cry…

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My heart is so full of joy, I can hardly hold it in… 
So let's all share that joy with each other!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How'd the investigation report go, Captain!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It was agreed that the trespassers would be acquitted on the 
condition that they stop entering without permission. 
No one student will be held responsible.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It seems the school administration will consider avenues to 
construct a safe space for students to reflect on themselves.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: And thanks to all your efforts, my job is complete!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To all of you on the Archive Investigation Squad… 
Mission accomplished! 
Thank you all so very much!
